title: Car-research- roadster dataset
description: Schema for storage/car_data.json — the authoritative structured dataset combining Phase 1 (model discovery) and Phase 2 (real listings) research for the Car-research- project.

metadata.description: Dataset-level provenance, methodology, and scope notes.

generated.description: Date the dataset was last generated/updated (YYYY-MM-DD).

scope.description: Plain-language statement of what this dataset covers.

phase1_methodology.description: How Phase 1 (model discovery) was run and its convergence/completeness caveats.

phase2_methodology.description: How Phase 2 (real listings) was run, including the price-threshold rule.

phase3_status.description: Status note for Phase 3 (purchase decision) — expected to remain 'not started' until Phase 3 begins.

phase2_price_threshold_eur.description: EUR average-budget threshold above which Phase 2 listing search is skipped.

specs_disclaimer.description: Caveat that engine/fuel/tank spec fields are good-faith approximations, not individually re-verified per car.

currency.description: Default currency for monetary fields unless a field's value states otherwise.

cars.description: One entry per roadster / open-top two-seat sports car model.

id.description: Stable kebab-case identifier, unique within the cars array.

tier.description: Free-text market tier, e.g. 'mainstream', 'premium', 'exotic (>100k)', 'ultra-exotic (>100k, sold out)', 'not yet available'.

model_variant.description: Generation / variant / trim detail and any relevant production-status notes.

average_budget_eur.description: Average budget in EUR, derived from real listing objects where available (Phase 2), otherwise from the Phase 1 estimate. Null when the model is not yet available/priced.

average_budget_basis.description: Explanation of how average_budget_eur was derived (which listings/estimate it's based on).

roof_removable.description: Whether the roof can be removed or opened at all.

roof_automated_process.description: Whether removing/opening the roof is an automated (powered) process or manual, as free text (e.g. 'Powered fabric soft-top (true)', 'Manual, unpowered soft-top/tonneau (false)').

fuel_or_charge_consumption.description: Fuel consumption (L/100km) or charge consumption (kWh/100km), approximate unless otherwise noted.

tank_or_battery_size.description: Fuel tank size (L) or battery capacity (kWh), approximate unless otherwise noted.

doors.description: Door count — always 2 for models in this dataset's scope.

phase2_status.description: State of the Phase 2 real-listing search for this model.

selling_items.description: Real for-sale listings found for this model (Portugal first, then Europe). Empty when phase2_status indicates none were searched or found.

link.description: URL (or named source) where the listing was found.

location.description: City/region and country of the listing.

budget.description: Asking price as displayed on the source, including currency (e.g. 'EUR 31900').
